segments.text: ALmyghtie God, which haſte geuen vs thy only begotten ſonne to take our nature vpon hym, and this daye to be borne of a pure virgin: Graunt that we being regenerate and made thy children by adoption and grace, maye dayly be renued by thy holy ſpirite, throughe the ſame our Lorde Ieſus Chriſte, who lyueth and reigneth. &c.
